Khaleda pays homage to Liberation War heroes
2016-12-16T15:06:54+06:00 | UNB, Dhaka
https://www.thedailystar.net/politics/khaleda-pays-homage-liberation-war-heroes-1330861

Marking the 46th Victory Day, BNP Chairperson Khaleda Zia today paid homage to the martyred freedom fighters who made the supreme sacrifice for the country during the Liberation War in 1971.

Khaleda together with her party leaders and activists placed wreaths at the National Memorial in Savar around 11:30am.

BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, party senior leaders Khandaker Mosharraf Hossain, Abdul Moyeen Khan, Amir Khasru Mahmud Chowdhury, Barrister Shahjahan Omar, Amanullah Aman, AZM Zahid Hossain and Ruhul Kabir Rizvi were, among others, present.

Later, Khaleda placed wreaths at the grave of BNP founder and her late husband Ziaur Rahman at Sher-e-Banglanagar in Dhaka.
